works.description: 以中國結編織工藝結合平安符概念，打造獨特的時尚單品，重新詮釋祈福文化，使其超越宗教應用，以創新且富文化意涵的方式融入日常穿搭，成為祈福的象徵。
works.longDescription: 現今許多宗教祈福用的平安符日益創新，使其更符合現代美學與大眾喜好。然而部分民眾並不會將其視為「必須隨身攜帶」的物品，而是將其作為象徵性的祝福，擺放於家中、車內或其他個人空間中。因此，嘗試以平安符上的「中國結」為元素，設計一系列中國結編織而成的包款，使其可以作為祈福的媒介，並成為人們會隨手攜帶的穿搭配件。
works.english: By combining the traditional craft of Chinese knotting with the concept of protective talismans, this unique fashion piece reinterprets the culture of blessing. It transcends religious contexts and integrates into everyday wear in an innovative and culturally rich way, becoming a modern symbol of good fortune.
works.english_detail: In recent years, protective talismans used in religious blessings have been increasingly reimagined with modern aesthetics, making them more appealing to contemporary tastes. However, many people still view them as symbolic tokens rather than essential personal items, often placing them at home, in cars, or other private spaces. Inspired by the traditional Chinese knots commonly found on talismans, this design explores a series of woven bags that serve as both a medium for blessings and a fashionable accessory—bringing cultural meaning into everyday wear.

works.description: 為需要久坐的長者設計符合人體工學的戶外雙人按摩椅，針對重點部位按壓，促進血液循環、舒緩不適，同時鼓勵走向戶外，提供舒適且具健康益處的休憩空間。
works.longDescription: 許多年長者因身體退化，需要長時間久坐。然而，長時間的坐姿可能導致血液循環不良、肌肉萎縮等健康風險，因此針對「背部」的重點位置，透過椅背上的按摩球設計、椅子結構的角度，讓年長者在坐下時能夠舒緩穴位。同時，為了鼓勵他們走向戶外、放鬆身心，而設計成戶外雙人按摩長椅，提供舒適且具有健康益處的休憩空間。
works.english: Designed for elderly individuals who sit for long periods, this ergonomic outdoor dual-seat massage chair targets key pressure points to enhance circulation, relieve discomfort, and promote relaxation. It also encourages outdoor activity, offering a comfortable and health-beneficial resting space.
works.english_detail: As the body naturally declines with age, many elderly individuals require extended periods of sitting. However, prolonged sitting can lead to poor blood circulation, muscle atrophy, and other health risks. To address this, the design focuses on key areas of the back, using built-in massage balls and an ergonomic chair angle to gently stimulate pressure points and provide relief while seated. Additionally, to encourage seniors to spend more time outdoors and relax both physically and mentally, the chair is designed as a double outdoor massage bench, offering a comfortable resting space with added health benefits.
